environment.runtime: Node + vite-node (TypeScript transformed); no production-browser/JIT equivalence claimed
environment.render: headless; canvas, browser layout and full frame timing excluded

contract.densityPolicy: World and scenario geometry scaled by sqrt(N/1000); physical radius/gap/speed/dt/grid cell sizes unchanged.
contract.qualification: Finite engineering comparison, not the research 10s warmup + 60s duration + 5 seed acceptance protocol.
contract.observerScope: Step timing excludes command dispatch, recorder/audit, process-memory sampling and JSON output. These overheads are reported separately.
contract.memoryScope: Independent child per case, no cross-case heap retention. Observed memory peak is sampled, not guaranteed high-water mark.
